svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.21.1.1 Application
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.21 MASONRY AND CONCRETE CHIMNEYS AND FLUES
Application

g.text: Serving fireplaces, or appliances with a
combined total rated heat output of
Other chimneys, gas vents and flue
Chimneys and flue pipes not covered

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
This Section applies to
(a) rectangular masonry or concrete chimneys not
more than 12 m (39′-4½″) in height serving
fireplaces or serving appliances having a
combined total rated heat output of 120 kW
(409 500 Btu/h) or less, and (b) flue pipes
connected to such chimneys.
Other chimneys, gas vents and flue pipes
serving gas-, oil- or solid-fuel-burning
appliances
and their associated equipment, including stoves,
cooktops, ovens and space heaters, covered by the
standards referenced in Sentences 9.33.5.2.(1)
and 9.33.5.3.(1) conform to Subsection 9.33.10.
Chimneys and flue pipes other than those in
Sentences (1) and (2) conform to Section 6.3.
Drawn: height measured from the base of the chimney to its top, the Article does not say where. Heat output converted at 1 kW = 3 412 Btu/h.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.21.1.1. (page 9-155)
